generation.prompt: Edit this tiny cropped terrain patch from a Heroes III snowy village background. REMOVE ALL WOODEN FENCES, fence rails, fence posts, rubble, tall rocks and obstructing objects, especially the fence crossing the CENTER of this image. Replace them with a clear gently level PACKED-SNOW FOOTPATH across the center, connecting naturally to the existing brown-gray snowy village lane. This is a clear walkway/door approach: no gate, railing, pole, log, cliff, rock lip, plant or obstacle anywhere in its middle. Preserve the exact input palette and illumination: warm pale snow near the lane, cool blue snow shadows, worn brown-grey snowpacked ground, small natural brush texture. No deep snowbank that blocks walking. Keep roughly the same terrain perspective/grain as the source so this genuine painted patch can be technically composited back into its original village. NO buildings, characters, text, symbols, labels, UI, hard rectangle, artificial paving slab, flat vector, Blender/3D render, modern CGI or retro pixel-art filter. Original Heroes of Might and Magic III painted2D ground appearance at compact native scale. The practical result is simply empty supportive snow/earth, with the former fence completely removed.
generation.method: Genuine imagegen whole-scene and local painted2D edits; technical crop/resample/bounded composition through pinned assembly. No procedural paving, 3D or render paintovers.
